Strategy: Add an exact-fit bonus on top of the eighteen sweet band and mid penalty, so perfectly filled bins always win. This tests the middle of the gentle steering range with exact fits, but the exact-fit override may dominate and hide the band effects.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (18 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (18 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
